name: Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B
description: Qwen 3.8 Max is a 2.4-trillion-parameter MoE model delivering a comprehensive leap in coding and professional work. Autonomously codes and delivers complete projects spanning 10+ days. Handles hundreds of specialized tasks across legal, financial, design, and other professional domains, producing production-grade results end-to-end in a single conversation. Native visual understanding runs through the full cycle of planning, execution, and verification, enabling deep semantic analysis of ultra-long documents and extended video content. In long-horizon tasks, plans autonomously, iterates through closed feedback loops, and continuously evolves.
